# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform integration and rendering reliability**

## Highlights

The next release modernizes Uno integration and improves Android frame pacing and native interoperability. Apple deployment requirements advance for Xcode 27. Linux shaping, WebAssembly linking, callback handling, and shader validation receive targeted fixes, while image copying and HarfBuzz text helpers reduce allocations.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Uno applications to Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno views now require Uno 7 and net10.0; obsolete native-renderer packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell linking are removed. Use Uno.Sdk's native assets and .NET SDK WASM pipeline. Non-Windows SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses CPU rendering, reports a null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering; the WinAppSDK control remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 12 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15 for Xcode 27 builds. Managed minima are aligned; update application deployment targets accordingly. These replace the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native floors, not any higher framework or application requirement. .NET 9 targets and existing Xcode 26 CI are retained. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android render loops** — Automatic GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent; WhenDirty rendering and lifecycle progress are preserved. This paces automatic redraws, not every request or frame presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order isolation** — Bundled HarfBuzz function calls stay within libHarfBuzzSharp even when GTK loads system HarfBuzz first, preventing incompatible implementations from exchanging private objects. Managed APIs and exported entry points are unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **WebAssembly native linking** — WebGPU C++ support is compiled into libSkiaSharp.a rather than on the application's final link line, avoiding C/C++ flag conflicts. JavaScript glue remains a link input, not deployed content. Newer consumers need rebuilt GPU-enabled archives; the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Native callback boolean widths** — Skia callbacks use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte hb_bool_t values, correcting unmanaged callback interoperability, including Mono ARM64 interpreter returns. Public managed delegates still use bool. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Character-code validation and native string copying** — StringUtilities decodes single-unit inputs by encoded byte width; use UTF-32 for supplementary code points. Null byte arrays now raise ArgumentNullException. FromCString also receives a native buffer over-read fix. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Shader rejection and GLES uploads** — The m156 sync rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. Ganesh GL no longer advertises unsupported BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads on GLES; readback is unchanged. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Fewer temporary image and shaping allocations** — Valid managed pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData, while HarfBuzz AddUtf32 strings use pooled encoding storage and feature formatting avoids native string allocation. Existing validation and decoding behavior are preserved. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention fix** — Corrects a retention issue in front-buffered streams. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integration dependencies** — Windows library dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. The packaged ANGLE backend advances to chromium/8118. These updates do not change declared Windows runtime minimums or public APIs. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
